fn SqrSumRec(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else ((n * n) + SqrSumRec((n - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (SqrSumRec(0) == 0)
  example (SqrSumRec(1) == 1)
